column1: Supplementary Table S1. PLSR nested cross-validation results for predicting the source-defined Cp trait (g cm?2) from canopy-level hyperspectral reflectance in Dataset 13 (n=305). The table reports the evaluated search space, the preprocessing–binning configuration and number of latent components selected within each outer fold by inner cross-validation, the corresponding outer-fold predictive metrics, the aggregate mean and standard deviation across the five outer folds, and the selection frequency of the chosen configuration. PLSR components ranged from 1 to 25, and the search space comprised 10 preprocessing variants and 4 bin widths (5, 25, 50, and 75 nm).
